questions.question: State strategies to improve nutrition in elderly people with feeding difficulties.
questions.solution_html:
• Nutrition in elderly people with feeding difficulties:Physiological
  • changes in old age like dental problems, swallowing difficulties, loss of
  • appetite, cognitive and digestive issues((2.5 marks)).Strategies include
  • texture modification(soft or mashed food),small, frequent meals, nutrient
  • dense foods or supplements ((2.5 marks)){K}/{}
